summary: This is a parameterized test that checks whether email values are not empty. The test runs twice—once with each row of data provided in the `with()` method—verifying that the email parameter in each case passes the assertion.

explanations.1: The `it()` function defines a test case with a description and a callback function that receives two string parameters: a name and an email.
explanations.2: This asserts that the $email variable is not empty; if it is empty, the test fails.
explanations.3: The `with()` method provides an array of data sets; the test callback will execute once for each array.
explanations.4: This is the first data set being passed in—a name and corresponding email address.
explanations.5: This is the second data set—the test will run again with these values instead.
